experienced.label: Experienced Professional (2+ Years)
experienced.rationale: Calibrates weight across commercial tenure, verified bullet evidence, architecture scope, and mandatory skills.

student_fresher.label: Student & Campus Fresher (0-2 Years)
student_fresher.rationale: Excludes the constant seniority pillar to prevent unearned point inflation (F19). Re-allocates weight to demonstrable project engineering artifacts, bullet depth, and core mandatory skills.

bands.label: Strong Match
bands.verdict: High textual alignment with target role requirements. Demonstrates evidence for core must-haves and quantified achievements.

bands.label: Partial Match
bands.verdict: Solid foundational competence; address missing mandatory technologies or weak unquantified bullets to improve review alignment.

bands.label: Weak Match
bands.verdict: Substantial textual gaps against mandatory JD requirements. Critical core stack items are absent or only listed without bullet proof.
